response.sql: WITH dc AS (SELECT a.district_id AS district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), ra AS (SELECT district_id, region, cnt, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM dc), ab AS (SELECT * FROM ra WHERE cnt > region_avg), r AS (SELECT district_id, region, cnt AS account_count, cnt - region_avg AS excess_over_region_avg, cnt * 1.0 / AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio FROM ab), k AS (SELECT r.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ratio DESC) AS rk FROM r) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, excess_over_region_avg, ratio FROM k WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY ratio DESC
